name: price_missing
description: The price feed never covered EPSIL, a held symbol.

name: price_stale
description: DELTA prices stopped five trading days before the as-of date.

name: price_spike
description: One ALPHA close is 30% above the previous close, then falls back.

name: settlement_lag
description: C014's depository rows arrive one trading day after the trades (settlement lag). Benign: must not be reported as an exception.

name: depository_feed_stopped
target: C015 DELTA feed rows after day 45
description: The depository feed stopped updating C015/DELTA after day 45 while trades continued.

name: unexplained_admin_increase
description: A manual (ADMIN) depository registration adds 500 DELTA shares for C011 with no trade behind it; the ledger closes the gap with an UNEXPLAINED_INCREASE plug.

name: oversell_plugged
description: The trade feed delivered C012's full-exit sell twice. The ledger goes negative and the gap mechanism plugs it back to the depository quantity the same day.

name: intraday_negative
description: A sell carries an earlier timestamp than the buy that funded it, so C013's BETA balance is negative for an hour; the day closes correctly (masked at the daily rollup).

name: fragmented_security
description: ALPHA also exists as ALPHA_V (same first 11 ISIN characters); C016's depository rows are stored under ALPHA_V while its ledger uses ALPHA.

name: duplicate_daily_row
description: One positions_daily row for C017/BETA is stored twice.

name: orphan_ca_reference
description: An extra dividend row for C018 points to a corporate action id that does not exist.

name: depository_snapshot_mismatch
description: C019's depository snapshot shows 10 more GAMMA shares than its own latest history row.

name: unlinked_isin_change
description: The ISIN lineage table lost the link for DELTA's market move, so received old ISINs can no longer be explained.

name: snapshot_stale_column
description: C020's snapshot updated the quantity after a sale but kept the old realized P&L.

name: daily_rollup_break
description: The daily rollup stored 50 fewer FIXED shares for C021 on day 20 than the ledger shows.

name: ledger_balance_break
description: One ledger row for C022 carries a running balance 100 shares too high.

name: avg_cost_jump
description: A sell changed C023's average cost, which a sale cannot do.

name: missing_dividend_event
description: C024 held ALPHA on the record date but never received the cash-dividend row.

name: version_drift
description: C025's GAMMA series switches calculation version for its last two days.

name: calc_stuck
description: C026's sale on day 54 sits in the calculation queue (PENDING): no balance, no daily row, stale snapshot. The depository already shows the sale.

name: registration_type_unset
description: C027's depository rows lost their registration type (informational field only). Benign for the catalogue; the rebuild reports it as Info.

name: leave_rejoin_not_ignored
description: C005's spurious leave-and-return row was not marked IGNORE. Within tolerance it looks like a one-day timing gap, so no check fires; only the rebuild catches it (scenario S07).

name: display_fee_constant
description: The app applies the equity sell fee to the fixed-income fund.

name: return_value_mismatch
description: The return engine's end value for C028 is 5% above the value of its holdings.

name: unknown_status_code
description: One return row carries a status code that is not on the known list.

name: dividend_counted_as_flow
description: The return engine counted C030's dividend credit as an external deposit.
